verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document user-defined rules that automatically trigger actions when events occur. The closest items are related but different features: Infra Analytics alerts on regressions (monitoring), Scheduled Rollouts (time-based, not event-triggered), Autotune traffic reallocation (a built-in bandit, not user-defined rules), and CLI/Console API automation from CI/CD (developer building blocks). None of these counts as an event-triggered automation rule engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
